A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the XCO2 from the EM27/Sun is biased low by 0.5 % and the XCH4 is biased low by about 2.5 % relative to the in-situ profile observations from aircraft-borne measurements.
the EM27/SUM data were consistent with those of TCCON within the measurement uncertainties.
the portable EM27/SUN instrument is a promising tool for measuring XCO2 and CH4 in the tropics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the EM27/Sun observations are consistent with in situ profile observations and that the air mass independent correction factor can be determined for a portable FTS.
the portable FTS can be used to measure the XCO2 with a precision of 0.5 % and the XCH4 with a precision of about 1 %.
the EM27/Sun XCO2 and CH4 data should be corrected by these factors to obtain accurate column-averaged dry air mole fraction of CO2 and CH.
